K_likely_future_topology.minimum_plausible_native_precision_topol: THEORETICAL -- a single 24GB-class GPU (L4/L40/A10G) is BORDERLINE for BF16: the ~22.8 GiB weight floor leaves little to no headroom for runtime/KV-cache overhead once actual engine memory usage is accounted for, matching the existing registry's own 'borderline -- no headroom' assessment. A single H100/H200-class GPU (80GB+) comfortably fits BF16 with real headroom.
K_likely_future_topology.safer_qualification_topology: THEORETICAL -- 1x H100/H200-class GPU (80GB+) is the safer minimum for a bounded BF16 production-serving smoke, given the borderline fit on a 24GB card
K_likely_future_topology.quantized_topology_options: THEORETICAL -- FP8 (~12.2 GB) and INT4 (~6.1 GB) both fit comfortably on a single 24GB-class GPU by weight size alone; no official quantized artifact confirmed this phase

L_precision_options.native_precision_artifact: BF16 (this repository, in dual on-disk format)
L_precision_options.note: Per phase instruction: a quantized derivative, if used in a future execution, must not be treated as the same registered control identity unless the locked evaluation protocol explicitly authorizes that precision/artifact -- this control's registered identity is the BF16 repository above.
